WHAT IS CRICKETX?

CRICKETX is a new game from smartsoft. In which you can quickly and easily win money.

HOW TO PLAY CRICKETX?

Enter the desired amount in the betting line. You have an option to place one or two bet on the same flight. The minimum stake is 0.1 DMO, and the maximum is 100.00 DMO.
Click the button–place your bet, observe-what height ball will take. The development of ball height is not determined and varies from 1 to infinity.
Use-before the explosion use collect, or use auto collect out function beforehand (on what height you want to exit the game).
Each bet can set manually or use auto for a pre-setted bet and collect multiplier. "Auto Bet" and "Auto Collect" functions activate after marking when a new round start. Minimum odd for auto collect is 1.35.
In the left corner of the game panel, coefficients statistics history are presented. Odds are reflected in the statistics after explosion of the upcoming round. Values are displayed in green and blue color: blue indicates the coefficients that are not more than 1.5 and green-more than 1.5.
You can only cancel your bet before the game starts loading. Once the loading countdown begins, you won't be able to cancel your bet.

HOW IS THE WIN CALCULATED?

The profit is calculated by multiplying the current height coefficient and the made bet.
Minimum multiplier (coefficient) is 1.00x. Max win 10000 DMO.

HOW DO I GET THE WINNINGS?

You have won the amount, if you had used the collect button before the explosion (the profit is instantly reflected on the balance). In the explosion happens, the stake is considered lost.
RTP for the game is 94.0-98.9%.
Game Version v1.0.0.1
The maximum RTP can be achieved by the player when opting to bet on the lowest possible crash multiplier (coefficient). Also when maximum coefficient to 25000x is reached, the win amount is auto collected.
